suggest.pusher/pusher-php-server: ^7.0 — required for PusherDriver (Broadcasting) to push events to Pusher or any Pusher-compatible server (Reverb)
suggest.matomo/device-detector: ^6.5 — required for Helpers::getBrowser() to return a version, platform, OS version and engine. Without it only the browser name is filled in: PHP's own get_browser() needs a browscap.ini that a default installation does not have.
suggest.vrana/adminer: Serves Adminer at /adminer behind the application's own gate: root usertype on any deployment, or the DevPanel's gate in a development environment. A suggest rather than a require, because a framework that shipped a database browser into every application's vendor/ would enlarge the attack surface of applications that never asked for one.
